inspiration: Skill effect library: a script-generated particle system in which each skill is a shader plus a particle config, with a property catalogue (l2-unity/L2_Shader_Property_Catalog.md; l2-unity/docs/L2Fx_Shader_Library_API.md). Keep the single reusable effect template with seed, fade-in, hold and fade-out timing. Change our own timing curve and colour grammar.
Batched name tags: all nameplates drawn in one draw call (README.md:19). Keep the batching. Change the plate shape and the font.
Four-state animation layer: the animator reduces to four states, with the rest substituted at run time (README.md:10). Keep a reduced state set. Change which states we pick.

Armour import by naming convention with a reference check: each armour piece is a mesh and a material found by a package-and-name convention, verified against a hand-made reference by vertex count, bounds and bone count (l2-unity/docs/convert-armor/README.md:5 and :216). Keep the reference check. Change the naming.
Reproducible particle spawns: spawn logs with seeds so an effect can be replayed (l2-unity/docs/SpawnParticleSnapshot_RngLog_Guide.md, listed, not opened). Keep the replay idea for effect QA.
Modular armour per body region: legs, arms and head are separate models per race (README.md:59). Keep the part-swap rig. Change proportions and ornament.

briefs.label: Modular race armour set by body region
briefs.why: Swapping legs, arms and head parts gives a readable silhouette at 375 wide, and the parts change on equip. Signature sound: an equip clank from the item sound family (category-level only; sound not opened).
keep: armour built from separate region parts (legs, arms, head)
change: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy: our own proportions per race
our own ornament and trim pattern
our own palette (target about 20-30 percent resemblance)

briefs.label: Staggered radial skill splash
briefs.why: A single burst reads at phone width. Signature effect: each particle starts at a random delay and fades in, holds and fades out.
change: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy: a different burst shape
our own colour scale over time
our own seed and delay ranges

one clear silhouette change per race
change: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy: our own body proportions
